meta.name: invoice
meta.description: 标准发票: 寄件/收件 + 明细 + 税 + 总额 + 付款指引

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成标准发票，包含明细、税额和付款指引
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成符合税务规范的发票
copy.tagline_en: Generate standard invoices with line items, tax, and payment instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate tax-compliant invoices

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成一张 A4 可打印的发票单页，包含发票号、日期、截止日、寄件方/收件方、明细表（描述/数量/单价/金额）、税额与总计、付款说明等部分，并应用打印样式。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成发票、账单等财务票据时触发。

say.text: 给我开一张 5000 元的发票，收件人写某某公司。
say.note: 生成一张含明细和总额的发票。

say.text: 生成一张带税和付款指引的发票，日期今天。
say.note: 会包含税额分解和付款说明。

say.text: 把这张账单做成 A4 可打印版。
say.note: 应用打印样式，适合 A4 输出。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will generate a printable A4 invoice page that includes invoice number, date, due date, From/Bill to blocks, line items table (description, quantity, unit price, amount), tax breakdown and totals, and payment instructions, with print styles applied.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to create an invoice, bill, or similar financial document.

say_en.text: Create an invoice for 5000 yuan, billing to ABC Company.
say_en.note: Generates a page with line items and total.

say_en.text: Make an invoice with tax and payment instructions, dated today.
say_en.note: Includes tax breakdown and payment notes.

say_en.text: Turn this bill into a printable A4 version.
say_en.note: Applies print styles for A4 output.
